Read the oil level and supply pressure; look for leaks at the pump, filter and pipe joints.
Level in its normal band, pressure steady, no leaks.
Read the filter differential pressure; take an oil sample for analysis.
Filter below its change mark; oil clean, no water or metal.
Drain and refill to the OEM grade and volume; clean the oil cooler.
Fresh oil of the right grade; cooler clean.
Look for material, gas or liquid escaping at the seal.
Inspect the seal faces, lamellae or packing for wear and damage.
Wear within limits; no torn or missing elements.
Listen for unusual noise; compare temperature and vibration with the readings in ULTRON.
No unusual noise; temperature and vibration in their normal bands.
Grease or check the oil to the OEM amount and interval.
Lubricated to schedule; no grease pushed out of the seals.
Measure bearing clearance; check housing and foundation bolts.
Clearance within the OEM limit; bolts tight.
Listen along the drive; look for oil leaks at covers and seals.
Smooth running, no new noise, no oil leaks.
Take a vibration spectrum and an oil sample.
No growing gear-mesh or bearing fault frequencies; oil clean.
Inspect tooth contact pattern and measure backlash.
Even contact; backlash within OEM limits; no pitting or cracks.
Compare current and winding temperature with ULTRON; listen for unusual noise.
Current and temperature in their normal bands; no unusual noise.
Open the terminal box under isolation; check connections, cable glands and the earth bond.
No discolouration or loose connections; earth bond intact.
Measure insulation resistance and compare with the last test.
Above the OEM minimum and no sharp drop since the last test.
Compare vibration with ULTRON; listen for rubbing or new noise.
Vibration in its normal band; no rubbing.
Inspect the impeller and casing for build-up, erosion and cracks.
Impeller clean, no build-up, erosion or cracks.
Read discharge pressure and flow; look for leaks at the seal and flanges.
At its duty point; no leaks.
Take vibration readings; check the seal flush or gland water.
Wear within limits; no cavitation damage.
Run a full stroke; look for hydraulic or air leaks.
Full stroke without sticking; no leaks.
Check the position reading at 0, 50 and 100 % travel.
Reading matches the travel at each point.
Read the differential pressure across the filter.
Inspect bags or elements; test the cleaning pulses.
No torn bags or holes; cleaning pulses working.
Watch the conveyor run; look for spillage and slipping.
Running centred, no spillage, no slipping.

Wear within limits; scrapers in contact.
Inspect splices or chain joints and the pulley lagging.
Look for hot spots on the shell or casing and for new noise.
No hot spots; no new noise.
Measure wear or thickness and compare with the last measurement.
Wear rate in line with the expected life.
Inspect the lining or wear parts and plan replacements.
Check cabinet and part temperatures and the cooling flow.
Check connections and insulation under isolation.
No discolouration, loose connections or insulation damage.
Compare the reading with related readings in ULTRON.
Reading agrees with related readings; no flat line or spikes.
Check the instrument at its calibration points.
Within the stated accuracy at each point.
Compare flows and temperatures with ULTRON; look for leaks.
In their normal bands; no leaks.
Walk round the structure; look for cracks, corrosion and loose bolts.
No cracks, heavy corrosion or loose bolts.
